name: oss-ontology-rulebook-to-rulebook
description: Extract a rulebook in the South Park ontology form into its concept rulebook: an injected rulebook comes back exactly as it went in; a native ontology becomes Things, a table per class, a table or a column per property, and ERBTables and ERBFields for what the structure cannot say (labels, symmetry, inverse, chain and disjoint axioms).
